programs.title: Cheese Slices
programs.desc: Making Cheese in Ireland dates back to Celtic times, but surprisingly it's only in the past decade that artisan cheese makers have revived the ancient art of traditional cheese making. Will explores the spectacularly rugged South West coast, and discovers a great selection of washed rind cheeses, blue cheese, and an unusual cheese flavoured with seaweed.

programs.title: Destination Flavour Japan Bitesize
programs.desc: In Japan's southern Islands Kyushu and Shikoku, Adam Liaw finds a vibrant, warm culture where old ladies use iPads to harvest the forests, and the cuisine is as fascinating as its people.
